lines.en: The stones crunch under my feet.

lines.zh: 咚、咚，脚步在石壁间撞回来。
lines.en: Thud, thud; my steps bounce off the stone.

lines.zh: 我抱着石球走，肩膀一歪。
lines.en: I carry a stone ball; my shoulder tilts.
I walk in the dark; one eye suffices.

lines.zh: 洞里太静，我在找心跳声。
lines.en: The cave is too quiet; I'm listening for heartbeats.

lines.zh: 一只眼慢慢眨，像在盘算。
lines.en: My single eye blinks slowly, calculating.
My boulder is up, and my aim is good.

lines.zh: 别躲了，我的眼睛看得见热。
lines.en: Stop hiding; my eye sees heat.

lines.zh: 一只眼也够瞄准，石头来了。
lines.en: One eye is enough to aim; here comes the rock.

lines.zh: 独眼一转，你就在我正前方。
lines.en: My single eye turns - you're dead ahead.

lines.zh: 一块石头，我扔得比你跑得快。
lines.en: I throw a rock faster than you run.

lines.zh: 我这只独眼，只看得见你。
lines.en: My one eye sees nothing but you.

lines.zh: 洞窟独眼巨眼冒金光，疼得我直发慌。
lines.en: My single eye glows in pain.

lines.zh: 独眼巨痛难忍，眼冒金星。
独眼巨眼被打伤，阵阵剧痛。
lines.en: My eye hurts from the hit.
I was in the water, it hurts.

lines.zh: 独眼巨被扔进虚空，好疼。
lines.en: I fell into the void, it hurts.

lines.zh: 独眼巨被魔法攻击，好疼。
lines.en: I was hit by magic, it hurts.

lines.zh: 你那食物的香味，真诱人！
你身上有我想吃的东西吗？

lines.en: Don't go yet, I'm still hungry.

lines.zh: 我的洞穴里有更好吃的。
你不吃我，也会被我吃掉。
你逃不掉的，我会追上你。

lines.en: You ran fast, but not far enough.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我的速度很快。
lines.en: You can't escape me, I'm fast.

lines.zh: 你最好小心点，别撞到我。
我们需要找个地方交配。
帮我搬开这块石头，我就信你。
lines.en: Help me shift this boulder and I'll trust you.
For our offspring, let's work together.

lines.zh: 这么大的洞，一个人守太冷清。
lines.en: This cave is too big to guard alone.

lines.zh: 你看起来不错，考虑一下吧。

lines.en: My cave is good for mating.
Find a quiet place to mate.
You picked up its golden pickaxe.
Its weapons lay on the ground.

lines.zh: 一具洞穴独眼巨人的尸体。

lines.en: It dropped a valuable golden pick.

lines.zh: 它掉落了诺米特锭和金镐。
lines.en: It dropped nommite and a golden pick.

lines.zh: 它朝你投掷了一颗石头球。
lines.en: It threw a stone ball at you.

lines.zh: 洞穴独眼巨人瞄准了你。
它的目光锁定在你身上。
洞穴独眼巨人准备攻击。

lines.en: Its stone ball headed for you.
It locked you as its target.

lines.zh: 洞穴独眼巨人的石头球。

lines.en: It threw a stone ball at you.
The smell of a living one seeps through the crack.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我抱着的石球。
lines.en: You stepped on the stone ball I carry.

lines.zh: 我一只眼，看得比两只清楚。
lines.en: With one eye I see clearer than two.
That golden pick in your hand, I know it.

lines.zh: 你掉下的诺米特锭，也归我。
lines.en: The aron ingot you drop is mine too.

lines.zh: 别藏在石柱后面，我看得见。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the pillar; I see you.
It aimed its eye at you.

lines.zh: 洞穴独眼巨人的石头球
它的石头球即将击中你。
lines.en: Its stone ball was coming for you.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，也够瞄准。
lines.en: One eye is enough to aim.
Its stone ball was aimed at you.
The stone ball turns half a turn in my hand.
I step back once, for a better throw.

lines.zh: 独眼缩了缩，对准你的胸口。
lines.en: My eye narrows, aimed at your chest.

lines.zh: 你跑动时，我的眼跟着转。
lines.en: As you run, my eye follows.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我挑了最圆的。
lines.en: This stone I picked as the roundest.

lines.zh: 石球出手前，会先响一声。
lines.en: The throw starts with a single thud.

lines.zh: 你的盾抬早了，我不扔那边。
lines.en: Your shield rose early; I aim elsewhere.
The roof is low; the ball will bounce back.

lines.zh: 我在数你的步数，第三步投。
lines.en: I count your steps; I throw on the third.
One eye locked on; you cannot slip away.
It's in for a melee attack!
It throws a rock at you!

lines.zh: 石球擦着洞壁飞过去，碎石四溅。
lines.en: The stone ball grazes the wall; chips fly.

lines.zh: 一拳砸地，石笋断了两根。
lines.en: One fist to the floor snaps two stalagmites.

lines.zh: 石球砸中你的盾，响声闷闷的。
lines.en: The ball hits your shield with a dull boom.

lines.zh: 我抱起整块石头，往你身上压。
lines.en: I lift a whole rock and press it on you.

lines.zh: 石球从洞顶弹回，砸你后背。
lines.en: The ball rebounds off the roof onto your back.

lines.zh: 我抡圆手臂，把这颗扔出去。
lines.en: I wind my arm and hurl this one.

lines.zh: 你贴墙也没用，石球会拐。
lines.en: Hugging the wall will not help; the ball curves.
This throw carries six points of force.

lines.zh: 石屑进你眼睛了，看不清了吧。
lines.en: Grit in your eyes; can you still see?

lines.zh: 我一脚踢飞石球，朝你滚来。
lines.en: I kick the ball rolling straight at you.

lines.zh: 洞壁裂开一条缝，独眼先亮。
lines.en: A crack opens; my eye lights first.

lines.zh: 地下的石堆里，我站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the rubble underground.
I was set on fire, it hurts.
I was in the water, it hurts.

lines.zh: 独眼巨被爆炸震伤，好疼。
lines.en: I was hit by an explosion, it hurts.
I was hit by an arrow, it hurts.

lines.zh: 独眼巨被魔法攻击，好疼
lines.en: I was hit by magic, it hurts
I fell into the void, it hurts.
